name: Friedman BE-100 (V2, 100 W, 4 x EL34)
description: Friedman BE-100 v2 as drawn on the 'BE-100 v2' sheet (layout by Equinox, drawing by Patrice Frey, REV 1.5, May 2014): Clean / BE / HBE channel switching on two relays, FAT, C45, SAT and VOICE switches, Marshall-type stack after a cathode follower, master, LND150 FX loop, long-tail PI with presence, 4 x EL34 fixed bias, bridge + centre-tapped HT, choke-fed screens.

sources.title: Friedman BE100 -V2 REV1.5 (lossless 1-bit PNG, 5706x1476), MEF thread 1013225
Owner reports of plate voltage (470-480 V) and factory bias (32 mA/tube), Rig-Talk

io.note: outputVoltsPerFS = 1.5 x the 128.6 V peak measured at the speaker dimed (HBE, gain 1, master 1, tone 0.5; 1.0 V, 220 Hz, settled start; the SLO-100 procedure). Into a 16 ohm resistor the Clean channel gives about 105-115 W at 5 % THD (1 kHz), against the 100 W rating; flat-out square-wave output is 156-174 W.

LND150.note: Supertex/Microchip LND150 N-channel depletion MOSFET on the square-law njf channel: VGS(off) -1.8 V (datasheet -1 to -3 V), beta 0.6 mA/V^2 so IDSS 1.9 mA (datasheet >= 1 mA) and gfs 1.5 mS at 1 mA (>= 1 mS); Ciss 7.5 pF / Crss 1 pF typical. The insulated gate is represented by a gate-junction IS of 1e-30 A (no conduction below about +1.3 V Vgs, which neither stage reaches). APPROXIMATE (no vendor SPICE card).

BZX79C12.note: BZX79-C12: 12 V at Izt 5 mA, Zzt <= 25 ohm (datasheet); nbv = Zzt*Izt/Vt

MPSA06_BE.note: MPSA06 base-emitter junction used as a zener: forward IS 20 fA; reverse avalanche ASSUMED 7.0 V at 100 uA (datasheet only guarantees VEBO >= 4.0 V; small-signal NPN emitter-base breakdown is typically 6-8 V).

No ratings printed: 1.7 k / 16-8-4 ohm taps, DCR 30 ohm per half / 0.4 ohm secondary, lm 5 H, lsat 2.5 are the Plexi/JCM800 netlists' 100 W EL34 values (ASSUMED). Leakage 3 mH per half (6 mH plate to plate) as the JCM800 2203 netlist: the loop-stability-critical unknown. With the Plexi's 5 mH this netlist (C36 4.7 nF across R51 raises the loop gain at HF) breaks into a ~24 kHz burst whenever the output stage clips (ngspice, step-converged; the engine reproduces it only from 384-768 kHz); 4 mH and below are clean.

multirate.note: FX loop (bypassed) and SAT clamp (off) as 48 kHz slow partitions (docs §10.65). At the catalogue settings five open contacts (K1_48, K2_139, S7A_1, S7B_4, SW7) joined the dead V1A / Clean channel, FX-loop and SAT branches to the amp through their 1 GOhm roff, so the main group carried 38 ports; each 1 GOhm now sits on a pair of grounded VCCS with a VCCS-only delay cut (the dead side reads the live node a sample late), the contacts drop out when open, and the main group has 25 ports (75 unknowns, 62 states). Exact: DI nulls against §10.63 -140 to -149 dB rms in 12 switch settings; alias and engine T/8 truth (0.018 / 0.041 %) unchanged. 9900X real / driven 112.5 / 115.2 -> 88.6 / 91.0 % of a core, block p99 1927 -> 1453 us.

lte.note: Base 384 kHz (minRate 352800, was 176400; docs §10.63). The aliasing gate's second tone (3130 Hz, own-mains mask) found 192 kHz base folds: -61.0 / -56.7 / -50.8 dB at 0.25 / 0.5 / 1.0 FS, now -69.5 / -69.1 / -66.5 (2900 Hz -71.0 / -62.0 / -57.5 -> -71.2 / -73.7 / -68.0). Event-local substeps (V1A at 8-32) leave the base folds (-56 dB); LTE tol 16 or a BE start at 384 kHz fail at 1.0 FS. Engine T/8 truth, band-limited, audio band, lead / rock DI: 0.064 / 0.157 -> 0.018 / 0.041 %. 9900X real / driven: 62.1 / 68.4 -> 117.3 / 117.9 % of a core, block p99 1371 -> 2023 us.
